blurb.text: A southeastern Rhône appellation, called Côtes du Ventoux until 2008, with vineyards in 51 communes of Vaucluse on the lower slopes of Mont Ventoux. Reds are made from Grenache, Syrah, Mourvèdre, Cinsault and Carignan, whites from grapes such as Clairette and Roussanne.
